Handmade paper clouds and fibrous blue paper sky. Clearly visible tactile paper fibers and natural crinkles throughout, substantial actual relief. Soft warm side light illuminates paper edges and casts believable layered shadows. This must materially look handcrafted from paper, not merely a color filter, flat illustration, painting, photo texture overlay or photographic landscape.
